exact_statement: For any actual Boolean g, physical seed query i, and independent nonconstant Boolean reservoir h with j=I(h)>0,s=H(h)>0, put G_N=g times N disjoint h copies. At fixed rate A>0 and eligible received cash R_N=A I(G_N)-u, with fixed old depletion u>=0 independent of N, define e=(u+D_iH(g)-A Inf_i(g))_+. For e>0 and all sufficiently large N the minimal newly frozen FULL entropy of an outcome-dependent feasible A058 transaction is Fopt(N)=e min_a (H(g_a)+Ns)/(A(I(g_a)+Nj)), with |Fopt-e s/(Aj)|<=e M/(ANj), M=max_a|H(g_a)-(s/j)I(g_a)|. Its advantage over common continuation is at most2eM/(ANj). Any feasible post-query decision using at most b fresh irrelevant fair bits per outcome freezes at least Ns/2^(b+1). Dyadic rounding with b_N=ceil(2log2(N+1))+b0 attains the positive ideal limit and can be implemented with fewer than2 expected dummy queries per nontrivial action. On arbitrary adaptive restriction trees of AND2 products, full expected terminal entropy is2(N-E distinct factors touched); coherent-mask transport gives E H(Fleaf)>=2(cN-sum_first-touch w_v t_v). This is a necessary terminal price, not a universal initial supplier or FEI proof.
